own_solution.law: Steady 1D conduction through series resistances: Q = Delta T / (R1 + R2)
assumptions: Delta T is the difference between the two outer surfaces

defect_reasons.other: T9AD7 ('warmed by a further 6.5 K before the test began') is ambiguous: the stated 20 K steady difference could already include that warming (answer 80 W) or the warming could be meant to add to it (26.5 K, 106 W).

notes: Base Q = 20/(0.1+0.15) = 80 W. TFD0A: Delta T -> 26.5 K, Q = 26.5/0.25 = 106 W (taking the new steady state). The absolute colder-surface temperature 303 K: with T_h = T_c + 20, Q = (T_h - T_c)/R and T_c cancels (C); it could also be viewed as K under constant thermal resistance. Partition sentences and earlier-test sentences are D. For T9AD7 I read the problem's present-tense 20 K as the test condition, so warming before the test is already included (D); the alternative reading gives 106 W. Variants: all numeric warming sentences state 6.5 K; T6D07/T97D1 are non-numeric; TFB08/TA36C both 303 K.
